name: A Curd Pudding
description: Historical recipe from The Virginia Housewife; Or, Methodical Cook (1824). Source method; not modernized or kitchen-tested.

ingredients.name: white wine
ingredients.originalText: half a pint of white wine

ingredients.name: loaf sugar
ingredients.originalText: half a pound of loaf sugar

ingredients.name: half a pint of rice flour or crackers
ingredients.originalText: half a pint of rice flour or crackers
ingredients.quantityText: half a pint of rice flour or crackers

instructions.text: Put two quarts of milk on the fire
When it boils, pour in half a pint of white wine
Strain the curd from the whey, and pound it in a mortar
Mix with six ounces of butter, half a pound of loaf sugar, and half a pint of rice flour, or as much crackers beaten as fine as flour
Add six eggs made light, and half a grated nutmeg
Beat all well together, and bake them in saucers in a moderate oven
Turn them out carefully in your dish
Stick thin slices of citron in them, and pour on rich melted butter, with sugar and wine

source.author: Mary Randolph
source.originalInstructions:
1. Put two quarts of milk on the fire
2. When it boils, pour in half a pint of white wine
3. Strain the curd from the whey, and pound it in a mortar
4. Mix with six ounces of butter, half a pound of loaf sugar, and half a pint of rice flour, or as much crackers beaten as fine as flour
5. Add six eggs made light, and half a grated nutmeg
6. Beat all well together, and bake them in saucers in a moderate oven
7. Turn them out carefully in your dish
8. Stick thin slices of citron in them, and pour on rich melted butter, with sugar and wine
